d:
27 year old Lisa Kwek as 8 months pregnant and can't wait to become a mother. Unfortunately she had been targeted by a corpse oil syndicate who has sent someone to kill her and then send her body to a witch doctor for corpse oil harvesting.

One night, the killer struck. He was told not to rape her to keep her body pure so he made love with her in other ways before strangling her to death.

Her body was dug up 3 days later and brought to the witch doctor where the ritual was carried out.
n: [Misc] Corpse Oil Ultimate Edition...for now (AI Generated)
